Container.Name: ironsbot
Container.Overview: EN: IronsBot is a NoneBot2 / OneBot v11 QQ bot image for Seer queries, group replies, Bilibili monitoring, activity reminders, AI chat, and Unraid deployment. Behavior and runtime settings live in /config/ironsbot.toml; environment variables contain only the config path and secrets. ZH: IronsBot 是基于 NoneBot2 / OneBot v11 的 QQ 机器人镜像，提供赛尔号查询、群聊回复、B 站动态监控、活动提醒和 AI 聊天等功能。行为与运行配置写在 /config/ironsbot.toml，环境变量只保存配置路径和密钥。
Container.Description: EN: Create /config/ironsbot.toml from the current config.example.toml before startup. IronsBot strictly validates this file and never creates, repairs, or rewrites it. Runtime data is stored in /app/data and file logs can be stored in /app/logs. Mount the Docker socket only when container image checks or self-update are required. ZH: 启动前请根据当前 config.example.toml 创建 /config/ironsbot.toml。IronsBot 会严格校验该文件，不会自动生成、修复或改写配置。运行数据保存在 /app/data，文件日志可保存在 /app/logs。仅在需要镜像检查或容器自更新时挂载 Docker socket。
Container.Requires: EN: Requires a OneBot v11 client such as NapCat. Point its reverse WebSocket to ws://UNRAID_SERVER_IP:8085/onebot/v11/ws, or ws://ironsbot:8080/onebot/v11/ws when both containers share a Docker network. Pre-create /config/ironsbot.toml and mount /app/data and /app/logs for persistent files. ZH: 需要 NapCat 等 OneBot v11 客户端。反向 WebSocket 可填写 ws://UNRAID_SERVER_IP:8085/onebot/v11/ws；两个容器共用 Docker 网络时可填写 ws://ironsbot:8080/onebot/v11/ws。请预先创建 /config/ironsbot.toml，并挂载 /app/data 和 /app/logs 持久化运行文件。
Container.Changes: Current deployment contract / 当前部署约定: - EN: All behavior and runtime settings, including superusers, listen address, command prefixes, and logging, live in /config/ironsbot.toml. - ZH: 所有行为与运行设置，包括超级管理员、监听地址、命令前缀和日志，统一写在 /config/ironsbot.toml。 - EN: Environment variables are limited to APP_CONFIG_PATH and six secret variables. - ZH: 环境变量只保留 APP_CONFIG_PATH 和六个密钥变量。 - EN: Missing or obsolete TOML fails startup; no compatibility or automatic repair is provided. - ZH: TOML 缺失或包含旧字段时会阻止启动，不提供旧配置兼容或自动修复。

Config.Name: Host WebSocket Port
Config.Description: EN: Host port mapped to the fixed container port 8080. Point the OneBot reverse WebSocket to this host port. ZH: WebSocket 主机端口，映射到固定的容器内 8080；OneBot 反向 WebSocket 连接此主机端口。

Config.Name: IronsBot Data
Config.Description: EN: Persistent runtime data, including caches, cookies, and SQLite databases. ZH: 持久化运行数据目录，用于保存缓存、Cookie 和 SQLite 数据库。

Config.Name: IronsBot Logs
Config.Description: EN: Persistent file logs. Configure filenames under paths in TOML. ZH: 持久化日志目录，文件名在 TOML 的 paths 中配置。

Config.Name: IronsBot Config
Config.Description: EN: Directory containing the pre-created ironsbot.toml. IronsBot never generates or repairs it. ZH: 存放预先创建的 ironsbot.toml；程序不会自动生成或修复该文件。

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: EN: Optional. Enables image checks and container restart/update through Docker API or Watchtower. This grants control over the host Docker engine. ZH: 可选。用于通过 Docker API 或 Watchtower 检查镜像、重启或更新容器；挂载后容器可控制宿主机 Docker。

Config.Name: IronsBot Config Path
Config.Description: EN: Required path to the strict TOML config. ZH: 必填，严格 TOML 配置文件路径。

Config.Name: OneBot Access Token
Config.Description: EN: OneBot connection token; it must match NapCat. ZH: OneBot 连接令牌，必须与 NapCat 一致。

Config.Name: Headless Seer User ID
Config.Description: EN: Optional Seer account ID for headless login. ZH: 可选，无头登录使用的米米号。

Config.Name: Headless Seer Password
Config.Description: EN: Optional Seer password MD5 for headless login. ZH: 可选，无头登录使用的密码 MD5。

Config.Name: AI Chat API Key
Config.Description: EN: Optional OpenAI-compatible API key. ZH: 可选，OpenAI 兼容 AI 接口密钥。

Config.Name: SendPic CNB Token
Config.Description: EN: Optional CNB token for configured SendPic repositories. ZH: 可选，SendPic 使用 CNB 仓库时的访问令牌。

Config.Name: GitHub Workflow Token
Config.Description: EN: Optional token for operations.data_sync remote builds. ZH: 可选，operations.data_sync 远程构建使用的 GitHub Token。
